final_recommendation.executive_summary: Royal Bank is a core Canadian holding — hold existing position. At $158, RY is fairly valued on a P/B basis (1.9x) given its ROE of 16.2%. The dividend yield of 3.6% provides reliable income. There is no compelling reason to add at current prices; equally, the moat and dividend quality argue strongly against selling. RY will be most impacted by the trajectory of Canadian mortgage credit quality in 2026-27, which is the key variable to watch. Existing holders in RRSP benefit from the treaty-exempt dividend treatment.
